                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length || this.isAnimating) return;
                this.isAnimating = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isAnimating = false; }, 600);
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                    this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
                }
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new SlidePresentation());
    </script>

        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isAnimating = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length || this.isAnimating) return;
                this.isAnimating = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isAnimating = false; }, 600);
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                    this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
                }
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new SlidePresentation());
    </script>
</body>

            --accent-secondary: #ff6b4a;
            --accent-warn: #f0b429;
            --border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            --border-accent: rgba(0, 200, 150, 0.3);

            --font-display: 'Archivo', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
            --title-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.3rem, 3.2vw, 2.4rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2.2vw, 1.5rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.35vw, 1.05rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            --label-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.78rem);

            --slide-padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
        }

        /* === VIEWPORT BASE STYLES === */
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }
        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* === GLOBAL STYLES === */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* === ANIMATIONS === */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.2s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.28s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.36s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.44s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.95);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* === PROGRESS BAR === */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s var(--ease-out-expo);
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* === NAV DOTS === */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vh, 10px);
            z-index: 100;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-muted);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* === SLIDE NUMBER === */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            right: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        /* === SHARED LAYOUT === */
        .slide-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 2vh, 1.8rem);
        }
        .slide-header h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        .slide-header .subtitle {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
            font-weight: 400;
        }
        .accent-line {
            width: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        /* === SLIDE 1: TITLE === */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
        }
        .title-slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(0, 200, 150, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(0, 100, 200, 0.04) 0%, transparent 50%);
        }
        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: center;
            padding-left: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 8rem);
            padding-right: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 8rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        .title-slide .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.35rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            border-radius: 4px;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }
        .title-slide h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 900;
            line-height: 1.05;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            max-width: 18ch;
        }
        .title-slide h1 .highlight {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .title-slide .meta {
            margin-top: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }
        .title-slide .meta strong {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .title-slide .divider-line {
            width: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 5rem);
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--accent);
            margin: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem) 0;
        }
        .title-slide .stat-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
        }
        .title-slide .stat-item .stat-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .title-slide .stat-item .stat-label {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        /* === GRID BACKGROUND PATTERN === */
        .grid-bg::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 50px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 50px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* === SLIDE 2: METHODOLOGY === */
        .method-flow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }
        .method-step {
            flex: 1;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
        }
        .method-step .step-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.2;
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            right: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .method-step h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }
        .method-step p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }
        .method-step .step-detail {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem);
        }
        .method-arrow {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .method-figure {
            margin-top: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .method-figure img {
            max-height: min(28vh, 220px);
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .method-figure .fig-caption {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        /* === SLIDE 3: TASK SUITE TABLE === */
        .suite-summary {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }
        .suite-badge {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex: 1;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .suite-badge .badge-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .suite-badge .badge-count {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .suite-badge .badge-desc {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .task-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 0;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }
        .task-table thead th {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: left;
            padding: clamp(0.35rem, 0.7vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-accent);
        }
        .task-table tbody td {
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.55rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.35;
        }
        .task-table tbody td:first-child {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .task-table tbody td:nth-child(2) {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .task-table tbody tr:last-child td {
            border-bottom: none;
        }
        .task-table-wrap {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .table-footer {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            font-style: italic;
        }

        /* === SLIDE 4: EXPONENTIAL TREND === */
        .chart-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .chart-container img {
            max-height: min(46vh, 380px);
            border-radius: 6px;
        }
        .chart-stats {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .chart-stat {
            text-align: center;
        }
        .chart-stat .value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .chart-stat .label {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

        /* === SLIDE 5: SUCCESS CURVES === */
        .curves-layout {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            align-items: center;
        }
        .curves-chart {
            flex: 2;
        }
        .curves-chart img {
            max-height: min(55vh, 440px);
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .curves-insights {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .insight-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.7rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .insight-card .insight-model {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .insight-card .insight-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .insight-card .insight-desc {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* === SLIDE 6: DRIVERS === */
        .drivers-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }
        .driver-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .driver-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.6;
        }
        .driver-card.limitation::before {
            background: var(--accent-warn);
        }
        .driver-card .driver-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }
        .driver-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.25rem);
        }
        .driver-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* === SLIDE 7: EXTRAPOLATION === */
        .extrap-content {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
        }
        .extrap-timeline {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            padding-left: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
        }
        .extrap-timeline::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 2px;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--accent), var(--accent-secondary));
        }
        .timeline-item {
            position: relative;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }
        .timeline-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: calc(-1 * clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) + clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vw, 0.25rem));
            top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            border: 2px solid var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .timeline-item.future::before {
            background: var(--accent-secondary);
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-date {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .timeline-item.future .tl-date {
            color: var(--accent-secondary);
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.35;
        }
        .extrap-callout {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .callout-box {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
        }
        .callout-box.highlight {
            border-color: var(--accent-secondary);
            background: rgba(255, 107, 74, 0.05);
        }
        .callout-box h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.3rem);
        }
        .callout-box p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .callout-box .callout-stat {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            color: var(--accent-secondary);
        }

        /* === SLIDE 8: TAKEAWAYS === */
        .takeaways-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }
        .takeaways-list li {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem) clamp(0.7rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .takeaways-list .tk-num {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.5;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            line-height: 1.2;
            min-width: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
        }
        .takeaways-list .tk-text {
            font-size: var(--body-size);

        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isAnimating = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length || this.isAnimating) return;
                this.isAnimating = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isAnimating = false; }, 600);
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                    this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
                }
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new SlidePresentation());
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        /* === SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER === */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isAnimating = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateNavDots();
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheelTime = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheelTime < 800) return;
                    lastWheelTime = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length || this.isAnimating) return;
                this.isAnimating = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateNavDots();
                this.updateProgressBar();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isAnimating = false; }, 600);
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (this.progressBar) {
                    const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                    this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
                }
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => new SlidePresentation());
    </script>
</body>
</html>
